Name: Plitvice Lakes National Park

Company description: The Plitvice Lakes National Park is open to visitors all year round. The touring and sightseeing zone mainly covers the area around the lakes and the waterfalls. There are many hiking trails and two educational trails. We recommend you obtain up-to-date information about the available tours prior to making your visit, as the tours are largely affected by the current season and the weather conditions in the Park. The opening times and Entrances available also vary accordingly. Please use the information you obtain in order to select the suitable outfit for your holiday. Another thing worth noting is the multitude of steps (the ascent) and the altitude difference of 133 m between the first and last lake (Lake Prošća and Lake Novakovića Brod). All three Entrances to the National Park are open from mid-April to the end of October: Entrance 1, Entrance 2 and the auxiliary Entrance Flora. In this period, panoramic train tours and electric boat rides on Lake Kozjak are usually available. Regardless of the point you choose to enter the Park, there are half-day tours (3- 4 hours) and full-day tours (5-6 hours) available. All tours are circular, most of the time you will walk and the program will take you back to the starting point. The tickets include panoramic train and electric boat rides in all of the selected programs. In case of snow or ice, the train rides will be cancelled. Please ask for the latest train and boat schedules in order not to miss the last one. Between November and mid-April, only Entrance 1 and the Lower Lakes are open to visitors. Access is more or less limited to walking. For day-to-day detailed information about the weather and the available tours, please call +385 53 751 014, +385 53 751 015 (Sales Office) and +385 53 751 022 (Entrance 1). Please do not hesitate to contact us for any information you need. We wish you a pleasant stay at the Plitvice Lakes!
